column1: # Cue words for context-cued numbers (languages/cues.py; docs/languages.md); format in
# hu/cues.tsv. Dutch writes compounds as one word: a trailing "*" covers the compounds and
# plurals that keep the stem (telefoonnummer, rekeningnummers). Matching ignores case and
# accents, and a space also matches a hyphen or nothing ("BSN-nummer", "sofi-nummer").
# Numbers that are not personal data: orders, invoices, customers, references, payment
# references, files and the company register (KvK, btw). Each ends the window, so
# Not a bare "btw": in English chat it is "by the way".
# Not "en" (and) or "of" (or): every pack's cues run for every text, and "en" is the
# French and Spanish "in", "of" the English "of", which often stand between a cue and its
# value ("phone number of the office 020 ...", "téléphone en cas d'urgence ...").
